stemMd: Why would annual crown-growth measurements be useful?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They guarantee that every tree will survive

options.label: B
options.textMd: They replace all later measurements of actual shade

options.label: C
options.textMd: They can show whether the trees are progressing toward the promised shade

options.label: D
options.textMd: They make the original timetable irrelevant

options.label: E
options.textMd: They prove that water is unnecessary

explanationMd: Crown development is an intermediate condition for future shade. Measuring it helps determine whether the project is on course before the final benefit is expected. Actual shade and survival remain separate useful indicators.

distractorRationale.e: Growth monitoring does not eliminate maintenance requirements.
distractorRationale.a: Measurements can reveal problems but do not guarantee outcomes.
distractorRationale.d: Progress is to be compared with that timetable.
